news.title: Perceived "Naturalness" Drives Public Support for Climate Tech
news.summary_en: O’Neill professor Kim Novick named director of IU’s Environment, Society, and Sustainability Institute, advancing interdisciplinary environmental research and solutions.

news.title: Perceived "Naturalness" Drives Public Support for Climate Tech
news.summary_en: New research finds public support for climate technologies rises when solutions are perceived as natural, offering insights for building trust and bipartisan support.

news.title: Committee named in search for O’Neill School dean
news.summary_en: Indiana University has named the search committees that will help identify the next dean of the Paul H. O’Neill School of Public and Environmental Affairs.

news.title: Attari named director of IU Institute for Advanced Study
news.summary_en: O’Neill professor Shahzeen Attari has been named director of IU’s Institute for Advanced Study, advancing interdisciplinary research and collaboration across campus.
